name: Family Council v2 - KB Progress Email

parameters.query:
-- Ingestion progress, plus the decision about whether to email at all.
-- fc_kb_notify_state is a single-row latch. While work remains we send updates
-- and keep the latch clear. When the queue drains we send ONE final email and
-- latch, so this workflow goes quiet instead of repeating "100%" every 5 hours
-- until somebody remembers to switch it off. Queue new files later and the
-- latch clears by itself, so reporting resumes.
-- The ETA assumes the throttled rate of one file per 15 minutes; that rate
-- exists because a faster one exhausted the Vertex embedding quota and took
-- the chatbot down with it.
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='done')       AS done,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pending')    AS pending,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='processing') AS processing,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='skipped')    AS skipped,
         count(*)                                    AS total
  FROM fc_kb_queue
),
prev AS (SELECT idle FROM fc_kb_notify_state WHERE id),
-- Clear the latch as soon as there is work again. Deliberately does NOT set it
-- here: that happens in "Mark Reported", only after the email actually sends.
reset AS (
  UPDATE fc_kb_notify_state
  SET idle = false, updated_at = now()
  WHERE id AND (SELECT (pending + processing) > 0 FROM cur)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT c.done, c.pending, c.processing, c.skipped, c.total,
  round(100.0 * c.done / nullif(c.total,0), 1)                       AS pct_done,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fc_kb_vectors)                               AS chunks,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT metadata->>'fileId') FROM fc_kb_vectors)    AS files_embedded,
  to_char(now() + ((c.pending + c.processing) * interval '15 minutes'),
          'Mon DD HH24:MI') || ' UTC'                                AS eta,
  (c.pending + c.processing) = 0                                     AS is_complete,
  ((c.pending + c.processing) = 0 AND NOT p.idle)                    AS is_final,
  ((c.pending + c.processing) > 0 OR NOT p.idle)                     AS should_send
FROM cur c, prev p;

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.is_final ? '✅ Family Council KB - ingestion complete (' + $json.done + ' files)' : 'Family Council KB - ' + $json.pct_done + '% ingested (' + $json.done + '/' + $json.total + ' files)' }}
parameters.bodyContent:
={{ ($json.is_final ? '

✅ Family Council knowledge base - ingestion complete

Every queued file has been embedded. The chatbot now has the full archive, and this is the last of these emails unless new files are added.

' : '

Family Council knowledge base - ingestion progress

') + '' + '' + '' + '' + '' + ($json.is_final ? '' : '') + '
Embedded' + $json.done + ' of ' + $json.total + ' files (' + $json.pct_done + '%)
Remaining' + $json.pending + ' pending, ' + $json.processing + ' in progress
Skipped' + $json.skipped + ' (unsupported file type)
Search index' + $json.chunks + ' chunks across ' + $json.files_embedded + ' files
Estimated finish' + $json.eta + '
' + ($json.is_final ? '

Worth doing now: re-test the Full Pledge access rule with a full-pledge and a non-full-pledge account. Ask both about meeting minutes (restricted) and about the Approved Policies folder (public). If the non-full-pledge account can answer the first, the gate is leaking.

' : '

Rate is one file every 15 minutes (about 4 per hour). That limit is deliberate: a faster rate exhausted the Google Vertex embedding quota, which also broke the chatbot, since it embeds every question through the same API.

Until this reaches 100%, questions about documents not yet embedded will come back thin or empty. That is missing data, not the Full Pledge access rule.

') + '

Sent by the n8n workflow "Family Council v2 - KB Progress Email", every 8 hours while work remains. It stops by itself once the queue is empty - no need to switch it off.

' }}

parameters.query:
-- Reached only after the email sent. Latches only when the queue is actually
-- drained, so progress emails keep flowing while work remains. Until this runs
-- the latch stays clear and the next run retries the send.
UPDATE fc_kb_notify_state SET idle = true, updated_at = now()
WHERE id AND $1::boolean;
